current_turn: The deploy to eu-west-1 is failing again. Can you get it green before the demo?

items.text: You are the on-call engineering assistant for Northwind. Never restart a production service without an explicit confirmation from the user in the same turn.
We have a customer demo on Thursday at 15:00 London time. Nothing can be down between 14:00 and 16:00.
By the way, I prefer terraform plan output over raw AWS console screenshots.
Understood. I'll hold any restarts inside the demo window and show terraform plans instead of console output.
Also, the eu-west-1 account is the one with the older IAM boundary policy - the deploy role there can't touch RDS.
kubectl get pods -n prod (eu-west-1): checkout-7d9f 0/1 CrashLoopBackOff (14 restarts); payments-2ab1 1/1 Running; search-9cc0 1/1 Running
kubectl logs checkout-7d9f: FATAL: could not connect to database 'orders': permission denied for schema public
aws s3 ls s3://northwind-artifacts/ | head: 2026-09-01 build-8871.tar.gz, 2026-09-02 build-8872.tar.gz, 2026-09-03 build-8873.tar.gz
GET /healthz eu-west-1 -> 503 (upstream connect error). us-east-1 -> 200 OK. ap-south-1 -> 200 OK.

Runbook 4.2 - Database permission errors after a deploy: the migration job grants schema privileges to the app role. If the migration job is skipped, the app starts but cannot read its own tables. Re-run the migration job, do not restart the pod.
Northwind expense policy: receipts over 40 GBP require a manager's approval in Concur within 30 days of the transaction date.
Onboarding checklist for new engineers: request VPN access, join #eng-general, complete the security training module, book a 1:1 with your manager in week one.
